rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping autonomous systems (drones, tractors, robotics) with real-time infrastructure requirements, while Saori's materials science background at Resonac could inform hardware and sensor innovation for next-generation physical systems. This is a complementary pairing where materials science expertise and robotics production experience could spark ideas around edge hardware and sensing for autonomous platforms.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Saori Miura — she's a materials scientist at Resonac who may have insights relevant to the hardware and sensor challenges in the autonomous systems you've been shipping at scale.
